content:
stages: [build, test, deploy]
build:
  stage: build
  script: pip wheel . -w dist
lint:
  stage: test
  script: ruff check .
unit-tests:
  stage: test
  script: pytest tests/unit
integration-tests:
  stage: test
  script: pytest tests/integration
deploy-staging:
  stage: deploy
  script: ./deploy.sh staging
